title: Cistanche deserticola Y.C.Ma protects rats against osteoporotic osteoarthritis by inhibiting the phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/serine-threonine protein kinase B/hypoxia-inducible factor 1 alpha signaling pathway.
authors: Wang, Fan; Zheng, YiZhou; Zhao, JiAo; Ye, JiaMing; Guo, YiFeng; Yu, Yang; Jiang, ZiYun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药肉苁蓉对骨质疏松性骨关节炎的保护作用，涉及PI3K/AKT/HIF-1α通路，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心对象为药物-蛋白相互作用，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Osteoporotic osteoarthritis (OPOA) is characterized by kidney deficiency, muscle debility, and lumbar weakness, which is align closely with "deficiency in kidney yang" in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) theory. As a tonic TCM herb, Cistanche deserticola Y.C.Ma. (CD) has been used for "reinforcing kidney yang" for thousand years. Although CD has been extensively studied for OP management, active components and mechanism of CD on OPOA treatment remain elusive. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aims to investigate the impact of osteoporosis (OP) conditions on OPOA progression and elucidate the active components and mechanisms underlying the therapeutic effects of CD in OPOA. MATERIALS AND METHODS: OP rat model was established by ovariectomy (OVX) and OPOA rat model was established by combining the established OP model with destabilization of the medial meniscus surgery. The bone-protective effects of CD on OP and OPOA rats were evaluated by assessing serum estrogen levels, bone metabolism markers, inflammatory cytokines, micro-CT scanning, and cartilage histology. UPLC-Q-TOF/MS was employed to analyze constituents of CD present in the bloodstream of OPOA rats. Network pharmacology, molecular docking, qRT-PCR, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), molecular dynamics simulations were used to screen and verify interaction between the active compound secologanic acid (SA) and key pathway genes. Finally, the expression of the phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/serine-threonine protein kinase B/hypoxia-inducible factor 1 alpha (PI3K/AKT/HIF-1alpha) pathway proteins and extracellular matrix (ECM)-related proteins was detected both in vivo and in vitro using Western blotting and immunohistochemistry. RESULTS: CD significantly ameliorated estrogen levels, serum bone turnover markers, and inflammatory cytokine levels in OP rats. Additionally, CD substantially alleviated pain behaviors, reversed bone microstructure deterioration, and inhibited cartilage degradation in OPOA rats. Fourteen prototype components were detected in the systemic circulation of OPOA rats after CD intervention, among which SA was identified as the key active constituent. Molecular docking, qRT-PCR, CETASA and molecular dynamics simulations revealed AKT1 emerged as a key potential target of SA. OPOA was ameliorated by CD and SA both in vivo and in vitro through suppression of the PI3K/AKT/HIF-1alpha pathway and restoration of cartilage ECM homeostasis. CONCLUSIONS: This study reveals that OP represents a potential driver for OPOA progression. CD ameliorated the progression of both OP and OPOA by alleviating bone metabolic imbalance and restoring ECM homeostasis. Mechanistically, CD could inhibit PI3K/AKT/HIF-1alpha signaling pathway, thereby restoring bone metabolic equilibrium and cartilage ECM homeostasis. This study provides modern pharmacological substantiation for CD's traditional kidney-tonifying and bone-strengthening effects in OPOA treatment.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：骨质疏松性骨关节炎（OPOA）以肾虚、肌弱和腰膝无力为特征，这与中医（TCM）理论中的“肾阳虚”密切相关。作为一种补益类中药，肉苁蓉（Cistanche deserticola Y.C.Ma.，CD）数千年来一直被用于“补肾阳”。尽管CD在骨质疏松（OP）管理方面已被广泛研究，但其在OPOA治疗中的活性成分和作用机制仍不明确。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨骨质疏松（OP）状态对OPOA进展的影响，并阐明CD在OPOA中治疗效果的活性成分及其潜在机制。材料与方法：通过卵巢切除（OVX）建立OP大鼠模型，并将已建立的OP模型与内侧半月板失稳手术相结合建立OPOA大鼠模型。通过评估血清雌激素水平、骨代谢标志物、炎症细胞因子、micro-CT扫描和软骨组织学，评价CD对OP和OPOA大鼠的骨保护作用。采用UPLC-Q-TOF/MS分析OPOA大鼠血液中CD的入血成分。利用网络药理学、分子对接、qRT-PCR、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和分子动力学模拟，筛选并验证活性化合物断氧化马钱子苷酸（SA）与关键通路基因之间的相互作用。最后，通过Western blotting和免疫组织化学在体内和体外检测磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶/丝氨酸-苏氨酸蛋白激酶B/缺氧诱导因子1α（PI3K/AKT/HIF-1alpha）通路蛋白及细胞外基质（ECM）相关蛋白的表达。结果：CD显著改善了OP大鼠的雌激素水平、血清骨转换标志物和炎症细胞因子水平。此外，CD显著缓解了OPOA大鼠的疼痛行为，逆转了骨微结构恶化，并抑制了软骨降解。CD干预后，在OPOA大鼠体循环中检测到14种原型成分，其中SA被鉴定为关键活性成分。分子对接、qRT-PCR、CETSA和分子动力学模拟显示，AKT1是SA的关键潜在靶点。在体内和体外，CD和SA通过抑制PI3K/AKT/HIF-1alpha通路并恢复软骨ECM稳态，改善了OPOA。结论：本研究揭示OP是OPOA进展的潜在驱动因素。CD通过缓解骨代谢失衡和恢复ECM稳态，改善了OP和OPOA的进展。机制上，CD可抑制PI3K/AKT/HIF-1alpha信号通路，从而恢复骨代谢平衡和软骨ECM稳态。本研究为CD在OPOA治疗中的传统补肾强骨作用提供了现代药理学证据。
